name: Sujeeth
title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
headline: I build data systems and dashboards.
tagline: I began by building data warehouses, ETL workflows, dashboards, and large data migrations. My work grew into analytics and data science, using SQL, Python, and statistical models to study performance and risk. Today, I build cloud data pipelines and tested warehouse models with AWS, Snowflake, and dbt, then turn the results into Tableau and Power BI dashboards. Across 10+ years, my focus has been making data accurate, understandable, and useful.
bio: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer with 10+ years of experience spanning data warehousing, ETL, migrations, dashboards, analytics, data science, and cloud data engineering. I use SQL, Python, and statistical models to prepare data, study performance and risk, and build reliable pipelines and warehouse models with AWS, Snowflake, and dbt. I turn the results into Tableau and Power BI dashboards that make information easier to understand and use.
